findings.message: Changing completed / total * 100 to completed // total * 100 causes integer floor division before multiplying by 100, so any completion share below 1 (e.g. 1 of 3 tasks) returns 0.0 instead of the correct percentage. It also changes behavior for negative values (floor vs truncating toward zero).
findings.suggestion: Revert to true division: return completed / total * 100
